answers.core: Everyone is a beginner when they use Godot, templates let them try other's projects. premade scene instances help them build their game at the scene level.
answers.workaround: I think this feature could add a lot of value, the problem with templates is they make mixing and matching a pain. I want the enemy of this demo, not the whole project.
